_: SCENE (SCEN): two NPCs talking to EACH OTHER, not to the player. A host quest (MF_SceneQuest, StartGameEnabled) owns two QuestAliases — one per actor — each UniqueActor-bound to a custom NPC. The Scene's BeginOnQuestStart flag plays it the moment the quest starts (i.e. on game load). The conversation runs in four phases (Borin opens, Hilda answers, Borin replies, Hilda closes); each phase is one actor speaking via a Dialog SceneAction that points at a Scene-subtype (SNAM='SCEN') DialogTopic carrying the line. Both NPCs are PLACED a few units apart in the Sleeping Giant Inn so they're co-located and can actually face/talk. Structural-only (build/validate/dump verified); not yet in-game confirmed — see docs/lifelike/cookbook.md. coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn after a save+reload and the two should converse on their own.

quests._: Host quest for the scene. startGameEnabled (default) so the scene loads/plays.

lines: You still owe me for the ale, Hilda.
Owe you? That swill wasn't worth a clipped septim.
Watch your tongue, woman, or there'll be trouble.
Trouble? From you? Ha! Buy me a drink and we're even.
